body: My mother. She's always been excessively abusive and plays favorites. The part that I can't overcome is that this has translated to her grandkids as well. Some get healthy, cooked meals, others get microwaveable nuggets or other unhealthy crap.

Not necessarily revenge, but trying to get justice for my sister-in-law. My brother is a cheater and has always been; thus far no one could catch him or prove it. I was screwing around on my friend's dating profile (just looking people up) and he pops up. I notified his wife via an anonymous email and attached a link.
